status: WIP, proposed values. Ratings were described by Whitney Hale in words; the numbers are a developer proposal and are NOT confirmed.
scale: Each dimension is 1 (worst) to 5 (best). Scores are inputs to the style weights in docs/routing-rules.md, rules H-03 to H-12.
attribution: Way IDs from OpenStreetMap (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.

rating_notes.noise: Traffic noise from I-5 and nearby roads (stated).
rating_notes.comfort: Some campers (stated); crowding at peak times is an assumption.

ns_spine.rule: Preferred route for north-south or south-north movement when the rider is on the east side.
open_questions: Does the preference apply to every style or only Greenway first, Scenic and Low stress?
How far off a straight line may the route go to reach the Esplanade?
Are there other east-side north-south spines to add?
